saw_lines: Nobody joins a study on impulse. People check eligibility, weigh time and pay, then ask whether it is safe.
So the sign up is won or lost in the first seconds, when a stranger decides whether the study feels safe.
Your 0 of 19 ads are video, so no stranger sees a real person first. Film three videos of a participant describing day one, then test them against your oldest ad.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 24 Nov 2026
points: 0 of 19 ads are video, so no stranger sees a real person before reading the ask. Trust decides sign ups. Film three short videos of a visit and a participant describing day one, then test them against the oldest ad.
None of your 19 ads shows a proof number, so a reader has no sense of how many people already took part. Collect one figure, such as people enrolled, and open the next batch with it on the creative.

2 of 19 ads are creator posts run from the brand page, which hides the voice that reassures a stranger. Whitelist both from the creator account and cut three variations opening on what the first visit was like.

0 of 19 ads carry an offer, so a qualified reader has no reason to call today. Give new participants one reason to act today, such as a clearly stated bonus for the first visit, and lead with it in three ads.
